title: Simulation 3D Ray Tracer
text: Implement ray tracing in 3D environment, 5 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent, {Coordinate system}, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z]} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw]} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Ray origins} sets the ray origin zeros, {Ray directions} sets the normalized ray direction ones, {Max ray lengths} sets the maximum total ray length ones, {Number of bounces}, {Visualize trace line} sets the visualize ray traces, {Enable optimization} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: HitNormals
ports.summary: Ray normal to hit location real-valued N(B+1) -by-3 array

ports.name: HitDistances
ports.summary: Ray distance to hit location real-valued N(B+1) -by-1 array

ports.name: SurfaceIds
ports.summary: Object IDs of hit surfaces integer-valued N(B+1) -by-1 vector | 0

params.name: Coordinate system
params.values: Coordinate system for actor transformation Default (default) | MATLAB | ISO8855 | AERO | VRML | SAE

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z]
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw]
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Ray origins
params.values: Ray origin zeros(10,3) (default) | real-valued N -by-3 array

params.name: Ray directions
params.values: Normalized ray direction ones(10,3) (default) | real-valued N -by-3 array

params.name: Max ray lengths
params.values: Maximum total ray length ones(10,1)*10 (default) | real-valued N -by-1 vector

params.name: Number of bounces
params.values: Number of bounces per ray 2 (default) | positive integer
